en: The image shows a night view of a dramatic, multi-tiered baroque fountain with a statue of Neptune holding a trident on top. The fountain is well lit and features ornate sculptures of sea creatures and figures. Behind the fountain is a medieval clock tower attached to a stone building featuring battlements. The sky is deep blue, suggesting dusk or nightfall.
